_comment: Tunable parameters. The branching of a round is logic and lives in src/forest/resolve.ts; everything that is a number lives here, because the numbers are what decide whether the game works.

fight._comment: A fight stands in for the trivia quiz: score = skill + itemEdge x items + uniform(0, luck). Raise skillSpread and the sharpest team wins; raise itemEdge and power-ups decide it; raise luck and anyone can win.
